classes.name: rx::MappedSubresourceVerifier11
classes.description: A wrapper class for D3D11 Texture2D mapped memory to facilitate memory error detection.

methods.name: ~MappedSubresourceVerifier11
methods.description: Destructor, asserts that internal data is cleared.
